rationale: Frozen 2017 is identified via e2 (Super Bowl LII, Feb 4 2018 game for the 2017 season, Eagles' first Super Bowl). e1 shows a later appearance: Eagles played and won Super Bowl LIX on 2025-02-09 (franchise's second title). Matching the frozen season-year convention (LII game year 2018 → 2017), LIX game year 2025 corresponds to season year 2024, so the last year they went is revised from 2017 to 2024; change_date is the LIX game date.
